look_here_first: Start with the fruit arrangement and opposite leaves. American beautyberry has tight rings/clusters of vivid purple-magenta berries hugging the stem at the leaf axils, plus opposite serrate leaves on a softly hairy shrub.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Williamson — county vascular flora lists Callicarpa americana. Travis — Pace Bend Park vegetation inventory documents American beautyberry in Travis County. Hays — project Hays-local source pool/native observation set includes C. americana.

best_field_traits: small pale pinkish flowers in axillary cymes
dense beadlike purple-magenta fruit clusters encircling the stem at nodes
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Opposite serrate leaves + dense purple berry rings directly at the nodes are the fastest confirmation.
